# `kernel/navi/NaviParticleNetworkAdapter.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/navi/NaviParticleNetworkAdapter.js`

NaviParticleNetworkAdapter.js — inert Navi/Particle Network protocol bridge. This module creates and verifies Realm semantic envelopes, but never opens a socket, fetches a peer, publishes a package, or owns a credential. Network dispatch remains the NetworkDriver's job. Contract verification and live authority are mandatory injected kernel decisions and fail closed.

## Classes

### `class NaviParticleNetworkAdapter`

Create a transport-only Particle Network adapter. `contractVerifiers` must contain one verifier per adapter ID. A verifier may return true, `{ valid: true }`, or the exact verified signed contract. The latter matches NaviContinuityService's purpose-bound verification methods.

### `class NaviParticleReplicationInbox`

Idempotent inbound application boundary built on Realm SemanticInbox. Verification and application are serialized so concurrent replay cannot apply one signed envelope twice.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
